QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Claudine, Lady of Mystery
QuestInfo.0: As soon as you entered #m310000000#, #p1013000# started yelling at you! What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# claims that the suspicious woman you saw at the Mine is #p2152004#, the doctor in #m310000000#! They look so different, but #p1013000# seems really sure of himself. Maybe you should look into it.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152004# acted like she didn't know anything about it, but something fishy is going on. Keep pressing her for information.

0.0: Master! I know who it is! That lady we saw in the mine is the doctor back in Edelstein! She's #p2152004#!\r\n#L0# #bWhat?! #p2152004#? No way, that lady in the mine was WAY scarier.#l\n#k
0.1: I'm absolutely positive #p2152004# is the same woman from the mine! She may be really good at pretending not to be scary right now, but you have to trust the eyes of an Onyx Dragon!

npc.0: She thinks she can fool the Onyx Dragon, but that is not happening!
